content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Aiken

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a secondary degree plus project-management experience, or a bachelor's degree plus relevant work hours. Review PMI's education and experience requirements to confirm you meet the baseline. Have your résumé and project history ready before you apply.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp. Our instructor-led course covers all PMBOK domains and exam content, delivered synchronously from your location. You'll earn the required 35 contact hours and receive a Certificate of Completion to submit with your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account and submit your PMP application, including your training certificate and work experience documentation. Pay the associated exam fee to PMI. Allow time for PMI to review and approve your application before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and study guides to reinforce course concepts. Schedule your proctored exam when ready. The PMP is a rigorous, computer-based assessment; our instructors provide guidance on test-taking strategy and common challenge areas.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll hold an active PMP for three years. Maintain it by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or published contributions. Plan your PDU strategy early to ensure you meet renewal requirements before your certification expires.
